invariants.rationale: The method accesses resources.get(type), which would throw NullPointerException if type were null, so type must not be null at method entry.
The method throws an exception if either name or resource is null, so at least one must be non-null at all times.
The parameter name is of type String, so it must be an instance of String.
The parameter type is of type Class, so it must be an instance of Class.
If resource is null, the method will throw an exception if name is also null; this expresses the required relationship for safe progress.
